title: Address checks before payment planning
description: An address is like a destination label with a built-in error check. Follow Bech32 decoding from characters to checksum and witness data, compare the simpler Base58 prefix/length screen, and see how the send screen rejects input before requesting a transaction plan.
learning_objectives: Explain bech32 checksum and witness program validation; base58 prefix/length screening; accepted address boundary in plain language.
Trace export function isValidAddress in `src/address.ts` and explain the relevant behavior.

State and preserve this limit: Validation is not ownership proof: the Base58 path checks only prefix and length rather than checksum, and the implementation is not a substitute for audited wallet software.
